archetypes.name: Selesnya Tokens
archetypes.plan: Build around Bronzebeak Moa: Populate valuable tokens, widen the battlefield, and use a mass pump effect to turn board advantage into lethal damage.

archetypes.name: Azorius Flyers
archetypes.plan: Build around Ascended Lawmage: Stall the ground with efficient blockers while evasive creatures establish a clock in the air.

archetypes.name: Simic Counters
archetypes.plan: Build around Beetleform Mage: Place counters on adaptable creatures, move or multiply them for favorable combat, and grow beyond opposing removal.

archetypes.name: Izzet Spells
archetypes.plan: Build around Blast of Genius: Pair cheap spells with creatures that reward casting them, using burn and bounce to sustain tempo.

archetypes.name: Boros Tokens
archetypes.plan: Build around Blaze Commando: Produce several bodies, enhance the whole team, and use combat tricks to turn a wide attack into lethal damage.

archetypes.name: Rakdos Aggro
archetypes.plan: Build around Carnage Gladiator: Curve aggressive creatures into removal and direct damage, accepting trades that keep the opponent under pressure.

archetypes.name: Golgari Graveyard
archetypes.plan: Build around Drown in Filth: Trade creatures early, stock the graveyard, and use recursion or scavenge-style payoffs to win the long game.

archetypes.name: Dimir Control
archetypes.plan: Build around Haunter of Nightveil: Answer early threats, disrupt the opponent's hand or library, and win with an evasive threat after stabilizing.

archetypes.name: Orzhov Sacrifice
archetypes.plan: Build around Maw of the Obzedat: Create expendable bodies, sacrifice them for value, and combine death triggers with recursion to grind ahead.

archetypes.name: Gruul Aggro
archetypes.plan: Build around Gruul War Chant: Curve efficient creatures into hasty pressure and use bloodrush-style tricks to punish blocks or force damage.
